retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast airbrushed illustration featuring a stylized vintage hot rod emerging from a dark background with dramatic, glowing headlight beams and sharp geometric typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, low-angle view of a red vintage hot rod with exaggerated fenders, set against a black starry sky. The composition is defined by two massive, upward-sweeping yellow and white light beams and a bold, horizontally-extended geometric logo at the top.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetrical car placement anchored by central grill
Dynamic upward movement created by light beams
Contrast between deep black background and vibrant red/yellow subjects
Integration of sharp horizontal lines with organic car curves
coreInvariants: Exaggerated, glowing white circular headlights with lens flare cross-stars
Deep red airbrushed gradients on car bodywork
Black background with sparse, sharp white star points

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The car is centrally located, occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame, scaled to feel imposing and close to the viewer.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The vertical black grill of the hot rod serves as the central axis.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bright headlights, follow the light beams upward to the top logo, then descend via the car's fenders.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive black negative space at the top and sides emphasizes the glow and the subject's isolation.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright Yellow and White (light beams and highlights)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the dark background and the luminous, saturated light sources.

letterConstructionRules: Extended horizontal bars that merge into speed lines
Uniform stroke weight within the main logo
characterSpecificRedesigns: The initial letter features a top bar that extends across the entire width of the composition
Letters are connected by a continuous horizontal baseline or midline stroke
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-impact custom display type paired with a clean, wide-tracked secondary sans-serif for legibility.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric, wide, and futuristic feel of the secondary text.
The primary logo requires specific horizontal extensions that standard fonts cannot replicate.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create an airbrushed illustration of a red 1930s hot rod from a low front angle. The car has large, glowing white headlights with four-pointed star flares. Two massive, soft-edged yellow light beams sweep upward from the headlights into a black night sky filled with tiny white stars. The car body has smooth red-to-black gradients.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, yellow, ultra-italicized geometric logo at the top with a horizontal bar extending to the edges. Add a smaller, wide-tracked gray sans-serif title at the bottom center, flanked by thin horizontal lines.

verificationChecks: Is the car centered and low-angle?
Are the headlight beams large and glowing yellow?
Is the top text extremely slanted with long horizontal bars?
Is the background solid black with stars?

adjustableVariables: Density of stars in the sky
Length of the typographic speed lines

mustAchieve: Sharp, clean geometric lines in typography

postGenerationChecks: Check for symmetrical balance of the car and lights
Ensure the yellow beams have a soft, diffused glow
Verify the typography is sharp and clearly legible against the black
Confirm the red car body has metallic-looking highlights
recipe.reuseFormula: Airbrush Technique + Vintage Automotive Subject + High Contrast Lighting + Geometric Speed Typography
